A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide the necessary and sufficient conditions for a GR(1) contract, and a symbolic construction algorithm for it.
we provide a symbolic algorithm for GR(1) specifications with nested goals.
we provide an algorithm to construct assume-guarantee contracts for synchronous systems, where each agent has full information.

, in the presence of liveness goals, the GR(1)-based synthesis algorithm can be adapted to handle assumptions.
